stem_en: For the hyperbola 7x² − 9y² + 63 = 0, the length of the latus rectum is:
stem_bn: 7x² − 9y² + 63 = 0 অধিবৃত্তের উপকেন্দ্রিক লম্বের দৈর্ঘ্য হলো—
explanation_en: 7x² − 9y² = −63 ⇒ y²/7 − x²/9 = 1. Here a² = 7, b² = 9; latus rectum = 2b²/a = 18/√7.

stem_en: For the hyperbola 4y² − 5x² = 20, the distance between the two directrices is:
stem_bn: 4y² − 5x² = 20 অধিবৃত্তের নিয়ামক রেখাদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী দূরত্ব কত একক?
explanation_en: y²/5 − x²/4 = 1 ⇒ a = √5, b = 2; e = √(1 + 4/5) = 3/√5. Distance between directrices = 2a/e = 2√5 · √5/3 = 10/3.
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch06; curated bilingual

stem_en: Stimulus: 16y² − 9x² = 144. Which are true? (i) asymptotes are y = ±(3/4)x (ii) directrices are 5y ± 9 = 0 (iii) parametric equations are x = 3 sec θ, y = 4 tan θ
stem_bn: উদ্দীপক: 16y² − 9x² = 144। কনিকটির— (i) অসীমতট y = ±(3/4)x (ii) নিয়ামক 5y ± 9 = 0 (iii) পরামিতিক x = 3 sec θ, y = 4 tan θ — কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation_en: y²/9 − x²/16 = 1: asymptotes y = ±(a/b)x = ±(3/4)x. Directrices y = ±a/e = ±3/(5/3) = ±9/5 ⇒ 5y ± 9 = 0. Parametric form is (4 tan θ, 3 sec θ), not (iii). So (i) and (ii).
explanation_bn: অসীমতট y = ±(3/4)x; নিয়ামক 5y ± 9 = 0; (iii) ভুল। সুতরাং i ও ii।
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch06; curated bilingual
